messages:
Sofia (Marketing): Quick thread to finalize the webinar run + accessibility + repurpose plan. Topic: "Serving LLMs in production: practical configs and what to watch for". Need decisions on captions, slide limits, audience engagement, and content reuse.

Noah (Demand Gen): Good. Please make sure captions + transcript are live. We lose too many registrants otherwise. Can we enable live captions and auto-transcript?

Marta (Speaker Ops): We can enable platform captions. Recommend: speaker notes submitted 48h prior so captions can be tuned. Also limit slides to 12 per speaker to keep pacing.

Priya (SR Eng): For demos: I suggest pre-recorded short clips for heavy perf tests (30-60s) and a small live snippet using a warmed sandbox. That avoids timeouts.

Omar (Solutions): Agreed. For architecture slide, I'll prepare 2 fallback diagrams: normal Dedicated path and degraded routed-to-hosted variant. Keep each diagram to one slide.

Kai (Mktg Ops): Tracking + forms: ask company, role, and primary interest (hosted/dedicated/private). Add checkbox for receiving benchmarking materials. UTM will be webinar_serve_042.

Sofia (Marketing): Engagement plan: poll at 10 minutes (which performance metric matters most?), short live Q (submit via Q&A), and a post-webinar feedback form. Who owns the poll?

Noah (Demand Gen): I'll own the poll and draft two options. Also request a 1-click calendar invite on the landing page.

Marta (Speaker Ops): Rehearsals: tech check (15 min) + run-through (30 min). Slots: Wed 11:00 PT for tech check, Fri 08:00 PT for full run-through. RSVP please.

Priya (SR Eng): Wed tech check fine. For slide deck: I'll keep 9 slides including one appendix with config samples (batch=16, kv_cache=true, quant=AQ8 example).

Omar (Solutions): I'll do 10 slides maximum. I'll include a short checklist slide: routing policy, autoscale min, fallback model id.

Sofia (Marketing): Accessibility items: captions on, transcript posted to recording, alt text for images, high-contrast slides. Also add a short description for any embedded demo video.

Kai (Mktg Ops): Ops note: recording auto-upload -> S3 bucket s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026/serve042. Transcript file: serve042_transcript.vtt. I'll add permissions for marketing viewers.

Noah (Demand Gen): Repurposing idea: 3 short clips (15-30s): benchmark highlight, routing pattern, customer ROI. Use in lead nurture and social. Also convert transcript into a 600-word blog summary.

Sofia (Marketing): Love that. We'll need timestamps in the recording to chop clips. Marta, can you flag timestamps during the run-through?

Marta (Speaker Ops): Yes. I'll note timecodes and share a spoiler doc with editors. Also confirm presenters are added as co-hosts in the webinar platform.

Priya (SR Eng): Quick content note: include one code snippet for an inference config block. Short, copy-paste friendly. Nothing longer than one screen.

Omar (Solutions): We should prepare a single FAQ cheat-sheet for post-event follow-ups: model sizing, security/compliance, pricing tiers, SLAs. That can map to our sales playbook.

Kai (Mktg Ops): Lead routing: enterprise-filter -> tag enterprise, assign to SFDC queue WEBINAR_ENTERPRISE within 2 hours; demo-requests -> create task in AM project board; general leads -> MQL nurture.

Noah (Demand Gen): Email cadence for attendees: immediate thank-you with recording & resources, 3-day follow-up with bench highlights, 10-day CTA for demo. Non-attendees get recording + highlights.

Sofia (Marketing): CTA language: "Request a capacity review" for enterprise. "Try Redwood API" for self-serve. We'll A/B test CTA phrasing on the landing page.

Priya (SR Eng): For the live Q&A, I'd like to allocate 12 minutes. Also ask registrants to upvote questions; saves time.

Marta (Speaker Ops): Calendar invites sent. Please drop bios + slide deck links into the shared folder by EOD Thursday.

Sofia (Marketing): Final checklist before we close the thread: captions enabled, slide limits confirmed, pre-record demo clips uploaded, timestamps for clip chopping during run-through, lead routing mapping done, post-event repurpose plan (3 clips + blog). I'll compile and share the final run-of-show doc.

registry-bot: Webinar event created: webinar_serve_042 scheduled 2026-05-13T16:00:00Z. Resources: recording bucket, transcript hook, registration webhook.

Sofia (Marketing): Thanks team 680. I'll post the final run-of-show and landing copy tomorrow.
